original_finding_content.subject: Mariu Bolaños (Trustpilot) — affiliate, not producer
original_finding_content.raw_text:
**What:** Self-identified affiliate ("Soy afiliada") reports unresolved refund request since February 2025.  
**Verbatim snippet:** "Soy afiliada y he comprado otros productos. Creía en la seriedad de la empresa, pero me decepcioné."  
**Source:** https://es.trustpilot.com/review/hotmart.com?page=5  
**source_type:** buyer_review  
**Date:** 24 abril 2025  
**Notes:** Reviewer "Mariu Bolaños." Excluded per scope: affiliate without substantive seller/producer experience. The review concerns a refund as a buyer, not selling experience.
